assumption: The caller is responsible for the re-execution in case of CRYPTO_E_BUSY.
rationale: SWS_CryIf_91021 defines the function as synchronous and describes no module-internal retry or buffering mechanisms in case of an occupied driver object.

original.text: Annahme: Der Aufrufer dürfte bei CRYPTO_E_BUSY für die erneute Ausführung verantwortlich sein — trifft das zu?
